choices.text: Zhongli, this gift envelope is for you.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Thank you. You're here at the perfect time — Director Hu brought me a pack of premium, aged "Iron Vermillion." It just finished steeping.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Thank you for the hint earlier.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Hah, your thanks are unnecessary — it was your sharpness of mind that put it to good use.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Many deserve thanks on this occasion — Director Hu for her steadfastness, the Ministry of Civil Affairs for their leadership...

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: As a consultant, all I did was help Director Hu prepare a few gift envelopes and fortune coins.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Not to mention, we have you to thank for Director Hu's safe return. So, if anyone is to offer thanks, that person should be me.

choices.text: Huh? Is that how it is?

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: #The tea is ready, {NICKNAME}. Please, have the first cup and indulge me with stories about your recent endeavors.

choices.text: How did you... make this about me?

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: May you have a blessed Lantern Rite. Take care!
